description: Two gates that stay shut until a set number of clock ticks has gone by, then let their signal through

params.text: Shuts that row again and sets its count back to zero
Sets how many clock ticks pass before that row opens, 1 to 64

inputs.text: The signal that row holds back and then passes
A trigger here shuts that row again and sets its count back to zero

outputs.text: The signal from that row's input once the count is reached, faded in rather than switched

notes: A row starts shut and opens only once its STP IN jack has counted the number of ticks set, so with nothing patched there the signal never reaches the output.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
